connector.name: Xstocks
connector.registryDescription: Buy tokenized US stocks (xStocks) on Solana via Jupiter DEX in USDC. Daily cap. Dry-run default.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package xstocks-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the evidai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: SOLANA_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Base58 Solana wallet private key (Phantom export). Leave unset for dry-run mode.

env.name: XSTOCKS_ALLOW_LIVE
env.description: Set to 'yes-i-understand' to enable real swaps. Dry-run by default.
